DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

The MRI results showing disseminated, nonenhancing white matter lesions, combined with your progressive cognitive decline, behavioral changes, and focal neurological deficits (right leg weakness/ataxia), are classic for PML, an opportunistic infection of the CNS usually caused by JC virus reactivation in immunocompromised states. Have you had a known history of HIV, recent chemotherapy, or immunosuppressive therapy?
